_comment: Hand-written label prompts per content id. Precedence: `labelPrompt` in the item's frontmatter > this file > a prompt derived from title/subtitle/body. Used by scripts/gen-labels.ts.
style: A small square painted illustration used as the label art on a retro game cartridge, in a cosy indie-game style: hand-painted with soft visible brush strokes, clean, crisp, saturated colours with a balanced palette (clear blue or lavender skies, fresh greens, warm accents) and soft daylight; NOT sepia, NOT yellow-tinted, not muddy, not an oil-painting pastiche. Slightly chunky stylised shapes with clean edges, like modern indie game key art or a charming storybook adventure game box. One clear focal subject with a simple bold composition that still reads when shown tiny. The painting fills the entire square edge to edge: no border, no frame, no rounded corners, no cartridge or device shown, no mock-up. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words, signatures, logos or interface elements anywhere.

prompts.tilttown: A crooked, Porto-style riverside town of tall leaning narrow houses with red terracotta roofs and colourful facades, stacked up a hillside above a calm river with a small boat, warm late-afternoon light, tiny figures on the quay.
prompts.inkwake: Full-bleed comic-book scene: a dark forest drawn in bold black ink lines and halftone shading, with a sweeping splash of wet black ink across the foreground, lit at the centre by a glowing teal crystal whose light turns the ink into a vivid drawn forest; the inked scene covers the entire square edge to edge, no blank paper margins.
prompts.hearthside: A cosy family scene from behind: a parent and two small children gathered around a crackling fireplace on Christmas Eve, a wooden table with a game board and colourful polyhedral dice mid-roll, a decorated tree with warm lights, a golden star glowing in the window.
prompts.edgewise: A tiny glowing computer chip resting on a fingertip-sized platform, with luminous neural-network constellations of connected dots and lines rising from it into a deep blue night like stars, warm and cool glow, sense of something small but powerful.
prompts.bots: A group of cute round plush blob creatures in pastel colours with simple dot eyes, one hopping mid-air, one dozing with a little sleep bubble, one looking around curiously, sitting on a soft knitted blanket, soft toy-like texture.
prompts.liquid-glass: A thick clear glass lens with soft rounded edges floating over a background of bold colourful stripes, the stripes visibly bending and refracting through the glass and its edges, bright caustic highlights, clean and playful.
prompts.speech: A vintage brass gramophone horn and a small cosy wooden radio on a desk, colourful sound waves flowing out of the horn and turning into a soft glowing voice ribbon, warm lamplight, a sense of a voice being captured and replayed.
prompts.bunker: A cosy round wooden bunker door set into a grassy green hillside, warm light glowing from a small round window and the slightly open door, a little path and lantern leading to it, wildflowers, like a hobbit home crossed with a safe vault.
prompts.tiny: A tiny cute paper airplane-shaped speech bubble flying between two small speech bubbles over a soft pastel sky, a few little plug-in puzzle pieces floating around it, minimal and friendly.
prompts.beambox: A row of small glowing glass cubes on a wooden shelf, each cube containing its own tiny cosy computer desk with a little robot working inside, warm light inside each box, like ships in bottles.
prompts.game0: Majestic floating sky islands with waterfalls pouring into a sea of clouds, a small wooden sailing airship catching the wind between them, swirling wind currents, warm sunset light, sense of a vast world to explore.
prompts.lfm-encoders: A brass railway switch junction in a painterly landscape where a glowing paper note travels along tracks that fork into several coloured branches, signposts with simple coloured shapes (no writing), one branch lit up as the chosen route.
prompts.js13k: A tiny pixel-art style spaceship game world squeezed inside a small glowing matchbox on a wooden table, bright retro colours spilling out of the box, playful sense of something huge packed into something tiny.
prompts.localdb: Close-up of a neat stack of three chunky green database drums (cylinders) with soft highlights standing on a wooden desk in a cosy study, a small potted plant beside them, a sunny window with blue sky behind; the scene fills the whole square edge to edge, no frame.
prompts.dice: A handful of colourful polyhedral RPG dice (d20, d6, d12, d8) tumbling mid-roll above a green felt dice tray, motion swooshes, warm tavern candlelight, one d20 glowing.
prompts.nostrschool: A small cosy schoolhouse floating on a cloud, connected to several other floating little houses by glowing purple threads like a web of relays, a friendly ostrich wearing a scholar's cap standing in front of the schoolhouse, warm light.
